description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, allowing chaining of LogNodes for customizable log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to log messages at various levels and manage LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to the given node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion message, optionally with an exception.
